Notices Made by the Governor of the Uva Province

I, A.J.M. Muzammil ,the Governor of the Uva Province, hereby notify by virtue of powers vested on me by the article 154(c) of the constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka through this order that the speciﬁ ed roads mentioned in the following schedule must be the roads belongs to Uva Provincial Road Development Department in accordance with subsection 6 of section 6 in part II and section 3 in part I of Uva Provincial Road statute No. 02 of 2010. Accordingly, I declare that the special gazette No.1856/40 and dated 03.04.2014 is cancelled onwards from 27.12.2023. A.J.M.MUZAMMIL, Governor of the Uva Province.
AS PER THE STATUTE OF UVA PROVINCIAL ROAD OF NO. 02 OF 2010 OF THEPROVINCIAL COUNCIL OF UVA PROVINCE, WEIGHT LIMIT OF ROADS UNDER SECTION 26.1

As per the road statute of Uva Province 26.1 in a ‘C’ class road mentioned in the following schedule the weight of the vehicle including the total weight of materials or people, animals and materials loaded should not exceed 12 metric tons, In a ‘D’ class road the weight of the vehicle with full weight loaded should not exceed 10 metric tons.
